'''Tarnahok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was stationed in [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Bren (SIS)|Bren]] send him to assist a Republic individual with recovering an [[HK-51 series assassin droid]] from the wreckage of the ''[[Fatality]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarnahok appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Republic quest "The Fatality" in [[Section X]].
